reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, evidence shows Anthropic is actively preparing for an IPO but has NOT yet filed an S-1. Multiple sources from February 2026 confirm the company has hired IPO counsel and is taking readiness steps, but explicitly state no public listing paperwork has been filed. The company raised $30 billion in February 2026 at $380 billion valuation and conducted employee secondary sales. While reports from late 2025/early 2026 indicated IPO timing as "early 2026" or "first half 2026," the actual S-1 filing has not occurred with ~4 months remaining before July 1, 2026. Given the preparation is underway but filing hasn't happened yet, and considering typical IPO timelines (S-1 filing to public offering takes weeks to months), filing before July 1 remains plausible but uncertain. Market conditions and regulatory environment appear favorable per 2026 IPO outlook.
